title: Enemy Drone Attack Targets Two Fishing Boats South of Qeshm
text:
Enemy Drone Attack Targets Two Fishing Boats South of Qeshm"

"Qeshm, 31 October – Two fishing boats belonging to residents of southern Qeshm came under an enemy drone attack a few hours ago, according to reports."

"Initial reports indicate that two fishermen are missing and two others were injured in the attack."

"The incident occurred 14 miles south of Qeshm Island, and the injured were transferred to the island."

"Searches are underway for the two missing fishermen, and further details will be announced later.
